responsibility: Defines the analyzer’s command-line options, warnings, dump switches, and tunable parameters for GCC’s option-generation machinery. This option table owns the -Wanalyzer-* diagnostics, -fanalyzer feature toggles such as feasibility checking, state merge/purge, call summaries, and inlining reconstruction, plus the -param analyzer limits and -fdump-analyzer* developer dumps that control exploration depth, reporting, and internal visualizations.
same_name_distinction: This same-name file is the analyzer’s option-definition table for GCC’s .opt machinery, declaring -fanalyzer flags, -Wanalyzer warnings, dump switches, and params. Unlike analyzer.cc and analyzer.h, it is not C++ utility code or declarations but compiler option metadata.
